USER GUIDE
1. WHAT IS THIS MANIPULATIVE?
5-ANCHOR SUBITIZING & BRIDGING TO 10
The human eye can only subitize 4 to 5 objects without counting.Ten-frames visually organize numbers into 5-anchors and complements: Number = 5 + n and 10 = n + (10 - n)Seeing 8 as '5 on top and 3 on bottom' turns mental additionfrom slow finger-counting into instant visual pattern recognition!
CALIBRATED 14.00 MM SUBITIZING GRID {xml_escape(dl)}\n{xml_escape(dl)}\n{xml_escape(dl)}\n{xml_escape(dl)}\n
TWIN 10-FRAME STAGE LID & REGROUPING
The lid features two side-by-side 10-frame stages. Place countersin both frames to model 2-digit addition and place-value bridgingacross 10 without losing track of regrouped units!
5-ANCHOR SUBITIZING: 5 + 3 = 8 (TEN'S COMP = 2)
INSTANT SUBITIZING Top Row: 5 Blue (anchor) Bottom Row: 3 Red (8 total) 2 Empty Slots: 10 - 8 = 2 Ten's Complement Bridge to 10: 8 + 5 = 13

✓ NO LOST PIECE LEFT BEHIND

Scan back QR or visit stackcalc.io/parts Order individual replacement pieces anytime
✓ 10-SECOND SELF-CHECKING PACK-UP
Pack-up is a built-in math game! Populate both 10-frames with10 counters each (all 20 counters accounted for). Lay the 10 goldrods into the center trough. Any empty well instantly spots a piece.Twin stage lid snaps flush for silent zero-rattle carry.
✓ HANDS-ON TUTORIAL ON REVERSE
Flip this card over for a complete step-by-step hands-on lesson with concrete numbers, stage arrangements, calculator cross-references, and The Big Aha! conceptual breakthrough! Keep this card stored inside the box lid!
